units.source_text: 天色渐明，但柏木依依不忍别去，他觉得反比未相逢以前痛苦了。

en.t: The sky was gradually growing light, but Kashiwagi could not bear to leave, and he felt even more tormented than before they had met.

units.source_text: 他对三公主说道：“叫我如何是好呢？

en.t: He said to the Third Princess, “What am I supposed to do?

units.source_text: 你如此嫌恶我，则再度相逢是无望的了。

en.t: If you despise me so much, then there is no hope that we will ever meet again.

units.source_text: 我但求你对我说一句话。”

en.t: All I ask is that you say just one word to me.”

units.source_text: 千言万语，缠绕不休，三公主不胜其烦，痛苦之极，越发不开口了。

en.t: With endless words he clung to her and would not stop, until the Third Princess, overwhelmed and in utter distress, shut her mouth even more firmly.

units.source_text: 柏木叹道：“想不到结果如此扫兴！

en.t: Kashiwagi sighed and said, “I never imagined it would end in such disappointment!

units.source_text: 像你这样固执的人，世间是没有的！”

en.t: There is no one in the world as stubborn as you!”

units.source_text: 他伤心之极，接着又说：“如此看来，无可奈何了！

en.t: Deeply heartbroken, he went on, “Since this is how things are, there is nothing more to be done!

units.source_text: 照理我可以死了。

en.t: By rights, I could die now.

units.source_text: 但我所以舍不得死者，正为了对你尚有这一要求。

en.t: But the reason I cannot bring myself to die is that I still have this one request to make of you.

units.source_text: 想起了今宵是最后一面，心中好不悲伤！

en.t: When I think that tonight is the last time I will see you, my heart is unbearably sad!

units.source_text: 至少你得对我说一句怜爱的话，那么我就死而无憾了。”

en.t: At least say one tender word of pity to me, and then I could die without regret.”

units.source_text: 便抱了三公主向外跑。

en.t: Then he took the Third Princess in his arms and ran outside.

units.source_text: 三公主想：“结果要把我怎么样啊？”吓得魂不附体。

en.t: The Third Princess thought, “What is he going to do to me in the end?” and was terrified out of her senses.

units.source_text: 柏木把角上的屏风推开，看见房门开着，便走出去。

en.t: Kashiwagi pushed aside the screen in the corner, saw that the door was open, and went out.

units.source_text: 他昨夜进来时所经过的走廊南端的门也开着，望见天色微明，还未亮足。

en.t: The door at the south end of the corridor through which he had entered the night before was also open, and he saw that the sky was faintly bright but not yet fully dawn.

units.source_text: 他想在天光下约略看看三公主的容颜，便把格子窗推开。

en.t: Wanting to catch at least a glimpse of the Third Princess’s face in the daylight, he pushed open the lattice window.

units.source_text: 用威胁的口吻说道：“你如此冷酷无情，叫我气得发昏了。

en.t: In a threatening tone, he said, “You are so cold and heartless that you have driven me nearly out of my mind.

units.source_text: 你应该镇静一下，对我说一声‘我爱你’！”

en.t: You should calm yourself and say to me, ‘I love you’!”

units.source_text: 三公主觉得这真正岂有此理，想对他说些话，然而浑身发抖，一句话也说不出来，那神情真同小孩一样。

en.t: The Third Princess felt this was truly outrageous and wanted to say something to him, but her whole body was trembling and she could not utter a single word; she looked just like a child.
